Name: (CP) High Purity Ore Node Tree
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[quote][color=#ff0000][size=6][b]﻿Notes![/b][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=5][/size][/color][font=Arial][size=5]If you install this mod with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14279]JA version[/url]﻿﻿ of the old mod, unexpected problems may occur, so please be sure to delete the JA version﻿ files when installing this mod![/size][/font][/quote]

[center]------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/center]

[quote][color=#ffff00][size=6][font=Arial]You can get ore even if you don't like mining!?[/font][/size][/color][/quote][b][center][size=5]It is a strange fruit tree whose trunk and leaves are made of stone.[/size]
[size=5]As it grows, it bears not fruit but a [/size][size=6][color=#f4f4f4]﻿”[/color][color=#ea9999]High[/color][color=#00ff00]Purity[/color][color=#ffff00]Ore[/color][color=#ff00ff]Node[/color][color=#f4f4f4]”[/color][/size][size=5].[/size]
[size=5]And we have original furnaces to process it.[/size][/center][/b]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=2]The prices of seedlings and fruits (node) are adjusted so that the game is not unbalanced to some extent. ... maybe.

Each of the five types of fruit trees bears fruit in the corresponding season. Some varieties may even bear fruit in winter!
(The all-season fruiting in the media images are from other mods for the photo shoot.)

Ore node buds appear on fruit trees in the fruiting season and the trees themselves appear a little brighter.

You can change the color of the machine and the price of the saplings in  "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]".

Much information is hidden.
If you want to know quickly, click below to check it out.[/size][/color]

[color=#ffff00][size=6][b]Explanation of what will be added by the mod.[/b][/size][/color]
[spoiler]
[color=#1e84cc][size=6][b]Merchant Dwarf[/b][/size][/color]
Merchant Dwarf will be added to the game when saplings are available for sale.
Note, it is not an NPC.
It is like a vending machine with operating hours. lol


[color=#ff00ff][size=6][b]Fruit tree[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]High Purity Copper Node Tree[/b][/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]High Purity Iron Node Tree[/b][/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]High Purity Gold Node Tree[/b][/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]High Purity Iridium Node Tree[/b][/size][/color]
[/list]These will be available for sale at theMerchant Dwarf once the conditions are lifted.
Each tree behaves like a vanilla fruit tree, producing "High Purity ore Node" when mature and in season.

[list]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]High Purity Radioactive Node Tree[/b][/size][/color]
[/list]Locked by condition When released, you will receive an mail and one tree sapling will be attached.
In order not to destroy the balance of the game, "High Purity Radioactive Node" saplings are sold at a very high price compared to other types.
Please take care of the one you get for free, attached to your mail.
If possible, I wanted to use the method of only having one attached and not selling it.
However, we decided to sell it as a remedy because we thought there were too many inconveniences.

[list]
[*][color=#00ff00]Copper Ore Tree[/color]
[*][color=#00ff00]Iron Ore Tree[/color]
[*][color=#00ff00]Gold Ore Tree[/color]
[*][color=#00ff00]Iridium Ore Tree[/color]
[*][color=#00ff00]Radioactive Ore Tree[/color]
[/list]These can be enabled in the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]" settings. (default is false)
These are by-products of the mod creation phase.
These, as the name suggests, bear vanilla ore themselves.
It's not very profitable, but it's a great way to make the farm bustle.


[color=#ffff00][size=6][b]Objects[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=4][b]High Purity Copper Node[/b][/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=4][b]High Purity Iron Node[/b][/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=4][b]High Purity Gold Node[/b][/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=4][b]High Purity Iridium Node[/b][/size][/color]
[/list]These are produced from corresponding fruit trees.
You can also earn revenue by shipping these.
It is originally intended for use in processing, but because it grows on fruit trees, we have set it up so that it can be treated like a vanilla fruit.
It cannot be processed in a vanilla blast furnace. A special furnace is required.

[list]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=4][b]High Purity Radioactive Node[/b][/size][/color]
[/list]Most of the specifications are the same as the others, but considering the price of the saplings, these Fruit are inexpensive.
This is because it is set up for the primary purpose of processing into bars.


[color=#ffff00][size=6][b]Machine[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=4][color=#ea9999][b]Magic Furnace[/b][/color][/size]
[*][size=4][color=#ea9999][b]Special Magic Furnace[/b][/color][/size]
[/list]A machine that can process "High Purity ore Node" and convert it to Bar.
This machine is also locked with release conditions.
By adding one node, two bars are created. No fuel is required.
It is faster and more economical than vanilla furnaces.
It also works as a substitute for a vanilla furnace with the ore itself.
The time it takes is reduced in that case as well.
The Special will create 6 bars with 3 nodes.
The time required is considerably reduced compared to processing the same amount.
[color=#00ff00]Specifications of "High Purity Radioactive Node"[/color]
Considering the rarity of radioactive materials ...
Three "High Purity Radioactive Nodes" can be processed into one bar.
This will be the same for both machines.
The only advantage of using "special" is the short working time.

[list]
[*][color=#ea9999][size=4][b]C r u s h e r[/b][/size][/color]
[/list]The "High Purity Ore Node" and various bars can be converted into ore.
It requires one coal for fuel to operate.
This machine was added to make better use of the "High Purity Ore Node" trees as they matured and the quality of the harvest increased, leaving a surplus of lower quality material that could not be fully processed.
The "High Purity Radioactive Node" is a bar that has limited use, so it can be converted into ore for use in crafting.

[/spoiler]

[b][size=6][color=#ffff00]Conditions for each release.[/color]
[/size][/b][spoiler]
[list]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]High Purity Copper Node Sapling[/b][/size][/color]
[/list]"Dwarf” friendship level is 3 or higher.
At least one "Copper Bar" is shipped.
Already have a copy of the "Dwarvish Translation Guide."
If you meet all of the above criteria, you will receive an mail. Reading it will initiate the sale.
[color=#00ff00][size=4]
[/size][/color][list]

At least one "Iron Bar" is shipped.
"High Purity Copper Node Sapling" is already in the stores.
If you meet all of the above criteria, you will receive an mail. Reading it will initiate the sale.

[/list]"Dwarf” friendship level is 3 or higher.
At least one "Gold Bar" is shipped.
"High Purity Iron Node Sapling" is already in the stores.
If you meet all of the above criteria, you will receive an mail. Reading it will initiate the sale.
[color=#00ff00][size=4]
[/size][/color][list]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]High Purity Iridium Node Sapling[/b][/size][/color]
[/list]"Dwarf” friendship level is 4 or higher.
At least one "Iridium Bar" is shipped.
"High Purity Gold Node Sapling" is already in the stores.
If you meet all of the above criteria, you will receive an mail. Reading it will initiate the sale.

[list]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]High Purity Radioactive Node Sapling[/b][/size][/color]
[/list]"Leo” friendship level is 7 or higher.
All other saplings are now on sale.
Remember all three machine recipes.
Entered "Qi's Walnut Room" for the first time and saw an event where I talked with "Qi".
Achieve one or more collections of each of the specific items derived from the Island.

[/list]                           Ginger

If you fulfill these requirements, you will receive the recipe by mail.
